item.title: 4 things to know about the Rhode Island shooting, trans-identified gunman Robert Dorgan
item.description: Within the span of one week, dozens of people have been killed or injured in two separate attacks in the United States and Canada committed by males who publicly identified as transgender. Here are four things to know about the latest shooting in Rhode Island. #RhodeIsland #LGBT #TransgenderViolence

item.title: Babylon Bee CEO urges Christians to produce 'more good books' to push back against bad ideas
item.description: In his speech at the National Religious Broadcasters 2026 International Christian Media Convention at the Gaylord Opryland Resort & Convention Center in Nashville, Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon began by acknowledging that the mission had changed. #BabylonBee #NRB #Satire #Evangelicals #SethDillon

item.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth slams 'godless left,' links founding of US with Christian principles
item.description: In a keynote speech laden with biblical references and patriotic fervor, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth addressed the National Religious Broadcasters' Freedom 250 Celebration by drawing a direct line from the Bible to the founding of the United States. #PeteHegseth #NRB #ChristianNationalism

item.title: Worship leader, 'American Idol' alum murders wife as children sleep, police say
item.description: A former "American Idol" contestant and church worship leader has been charged in the fatal shooting of his wife inside their Ohio home. #AmericanIdol #ChurchWorshipLeader #CalebFlynn #FatalShooting #Ohio #Murder

item.title: Christians face 'scapegoating,' rising arrests in Iran amid political upheaval: 'Horrifying'
item.description: A joint annual report released this week highlighting rights violations in Iran warned that 254 Christians were arrested in the Muslim country last year because of their faith, and that Iranian Christians increasingly face "scapegoating" as they are blamed and targeted amid political tensions. #Iran #persecution #Islam

item.title: CNN doc links 'Christian nationalism' to Kirk assassination, warns of classical Christian schools
item.description: CNN has been repeatedly teasing an hour-long documentary this week about so-called Christian nationalism set to air Sunday on the network, which has drawn backlash for appearing to link an alleged rise in the ideology to Charlie Kirk's assassination last fall. #CNN #Christiannationalism #CharlieKirk

item.title: Trump's week in review: New refugee policy, Board of Peace meeting
item.description: The past week saw multiple developments from Washington, including the president's sweeping tariff policy being struck down by the nation's highest court. #DonaldTrump #Iran #Gaza #BoardofPeace #MarcoRubio #WorldRelief #MyalGreene #Refugees #Immigration

item.title: This week in Christian history: Queen Elizabeth I excommunicated, first Methodist church chartered
item.description: Events that occurred this week in Christian history include the excommunication of Queen Elizabeth I, the first chartered Methodist church in the United States, and the death of Amanda Smith. #QueenElizabethI #AmandaSmith #JohnWesley #missionary #Methodism #history #pope #excommunicates

item.title: 7 interesting facts about George Washington
item.description: Sunday marks the 295th birthday of George Washington, the first president of the United States. While endless volumes have been written about Washington since the 18th century, several interesting facts about the prominent man are lesser known. Here are seven interesting facts about George Washington. #GeorgeWashington #history #America250 #president #foundingfather

item.title: First-grade teacher threatened with termination for refusing to read LGBT-themed book: attorneys
item.description: A first-grade teacher in Nashville, Tennessee, claims that he was threatened with termination and reassigned to a new position after requesting religious accommodations to avoid reading books to children that promote same-sex marriage, which would have conflicted with his beliefs about marriage and sexuality. #religiousliberty #parentalrights #FirstAmendment #LGBT #samesexmarriage
